verdict.rationale: Hummingbird is an AML case-management and alert-dispositioning platform, so measuring detection quality is a fair axis. The evidence does not document any way to score detection accuracy or incorrect clearances against labelled validation cases. The analytics CSV export, audit trail and jurisdictional filing validation are adjacent features, not detection-quality measurement.

support.subject: As a risk-analyst, I can measure detection quality and incorrect clearances against labelled validation cases
